_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We serve three primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2012 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We serve three primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2012 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.09x; +28% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.72; conservative 2yr +4%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY08-FY12 ex-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -1.2%/yr (Q1 FY13 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.2-yr ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +71.5%/yr (FY08-FY12 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY12 ex-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2012-12-31) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.09x (20.4% downside to Bear $25.20 / +222.1% upside to Bull $101.95) | Adj composite 2.34 vs market 1.62: gap +0.72 [UNDERVALUED] | +28% above the EPP floor $24.75 (11x FY13E $2.25) | Conservative 2-yr case: +4.0% total (+2.0%/yr) | At 14.1x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $41.86 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net revenue -0.8% YoY in Q4 FY12, forward revenues -0.1% to +4.3% (Q1 FY13 revenue guide (Q4 FY12 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
